beats.text: At a White House event with RFK Junior and Dr. Oz, Trump told pregnant women: stop taking Tylenol.

beats.caption: You shouldn't give a Tylenol to that child.
beats.label: via LiveNOW from FOX

beats.text: Acetaminophen has never been proven to cause autism. Doctors call it reckless. Then came the vaccine math.

beats.caption: You get a a vat of 80 different vaccines.
beats.label: via LiveNOW from FOX

beats.text: PolitiFact rated the '80 vaccines' claim False; the real schedule is nowhere close. Back at the mic, more Tylenol.

beats.caption: Don't take it. There's there's no downside in not taking it.
beats.label: via LiveNOW from FOX

beats.text: PolitiFact's verdict: Pants Fire. Doctors say the actual downside is untreated fevers in pregnancy.
